reviews.text:
Thank you so much for your feedback, Jose Javier.

We're delighted that you had a positive experience with our work.
Thank you for choosing Adiestrador Madrid!

We are thrilled with the work done with our American Bully. From the very first moment, the trainer instilled a great deal of confidence and professionalism, and perfectly understood our dog's needs and personality.
He has helped us tremendously to better understand his behavior and, above all, has taught us how to act in different situations. We have noticed a huge change and now have many more tools and greater confidence to manage certain behaviors.

Without a doubt, we are very happy with the result and recommend him 100%. A true professional!

I want to thank you for your great work and professionalism. Following the guidelines you gave me in the first session, my pet is now calmer and more balanced. I've noticed a big change, and I will continue working with you on his fears. We'll get through this together. Thank you, Miguel and Elena!

We are so happy with the work we did with Miguel training our dog Lua. It's a service that goes far beyond the individual sessions. It's constant learning, supervision, and support throughout the process.

We thought it would be impossible to stop her barking and becoming defensive in public, but now she gets along wonderfully with other dogs. We went from dreading walks because of her reactions to being able to enjoy them with peace of mind, knowing everything will be fine.

Thank you so much, Madrid dog training team!

Finding Miguel has been a game-changer for our dog Canela, a mixed-breed greyhound and Belgian Shepherd. She was very sociable with other dogs until she was bitten, and walks became a nightmare. She would become very aggressive with almost every dog ​​we met. Thanks to Miguel, the change has been spectacular. It's a pleasure to go out with Canela, to see her enjoy herself, be calm, and play with other dogs. It's a huge relief for us. Thank you, Miguel, for your kindness, your professionalism, and your love for animals.

Miguel is wonderful! He gave me some great advice, and it worked perfectly. I thought it was impossible for my dog ​​to correct certain behaviors, but thanks to Miguel's professionalism and experience, I can say that my dog ​​is a much more balanced and happy animal. And so am I. Because the help he provides in raising and training our pets is truly beneficial. It's one of the best investments I've ever made, and they also offer flexible payment options, allowing you to book individual sessions or packages, so there's something for everyone's needs. I can say that Miguel's help is absolutely fantastic. He has changed my life for the better! 😀

We found Miguel, and to tell you the truth... I don't know how... I think it was life that wanted to give us another chance, especially me. Rhys is a nearly three-year-old dog with anxiety, fears, and insecurities... all of this towards both dogs and people. It was poorly managed from the beginning, since Rhys was thrown in a garbage container when he was only 4-5 weeks old. We believe that's where, and even before, his bitter relationship with life and humans began. He didn't know how to manage his fears, and there were only two possibilities: loving and even clingy, or reactive to stimuli he considered a threat to himself or to me because of my physical vulnerability (I need support to walk).

From day one, Miguel knew how to communicate with him, with respect but firmness. He taught us to understand him, to manage his fears in public, to walk without "terror," which is how I used to go out, afraid of encountering a small dog, one of his perceived threats, or any person, thing, or creature that he saw as a threat.

We continue working with Miguel and ourselves to this day, but we can say that Rhys is a different dog. He runs, enjoys being outside, and socializes with more dogs than just his close circle. I think sometimes even he can't believe it, and all of this is thanks to his trainer's guidance. So, we have nothing but words of gratitude, and I sincerely recommend the work he does with dogs.
Training, communication, explanations of why things happen... that's why I say that life gave us another chance by putting us in his hands.

Thank you, Miguel!!!
Paula, Carla, Rhys, and Susana 🩷🫂

Highly recommended. I noticed the change in my dog ​​from the very first moment. She exudes so much calm and passion for what she does, in addition to having a wealth of knowledge and resources. I only have words of gratitude for the help she has provided ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Miguel is a true professional. We're still in the process, but we've already seen changes in Willow and Kroos. Willow used to be very reactive with people and some dogs, and Kroos cried a lot when we left the house. Thanks to his techniques, we can finally see the light at the end of the tunnel! We're so happy. Thank you, Miguel!! 🐶🐶

Our 11-month-old beagle couldn't stay home alone for even a minute. He'd bark and howl like crazy. We contacted Miguel, and we've been practicing leaving him alone for over a month now, and it's going great. He's a true professional. We still have a few things to work on, but little by little, with his help, we'll get there. I also want to highlight the Sunday dog ​​walks, which I think are a fantastic initiative and a great experience that I recommend to everyone.

We're currently training with Miguel and we couldn't be happier. We learn something new every session, and it's always done with respect and trust for everyone involved. We can never thank him enough for all the work he's done. 100% recommended!

We came to Miguel after a bad experience, and honestly, from the very first moment, everything was different. His way of working with Archie and with us was always motivating and yielded excellent results. We definitely recommend him!

Talking about Miguel is easy. He helped me a lot with my children, and I look up to him for any unexpected situation. Tobi is a smart dog, but it wasn't easy for us to walk him, or for him to accept other dogs... I think he's not very sociable by nature, but thanks to this wonderful person, we can now say that he has learned to tolerate others. We recently added a new member to the family, Peque, and his patience, tenacity, empathy, charisma, and perseverance have made the difficult seem easy. THANK YOU, MIGUEL

Having Miguel on board has been a great decision in helping Nor become a happier dog every day. Without a doubt, recommending Miguel is practically a must if you want to properly train your furry friend. Thank you for everything.

Miguel has been key to our little one's training! The classes have been very interesting, and we've learned so much about dog behavior! He's also always willing to continue helping us after the classes are over! We're thrilled with the results, and we'll definitely be using his services again in the future! Thank you so much, Miguel, for everything! It's been a pleasure.

We contacted Miguel a few months ago because our German Shepherd mix was exhibiting inappropriate reactions and behaviors, and he also had difficulty socializing with other dogs. We were overwhelmed and decided to seek help.
We found Miguel, and besides being a true professional, it's clear he loves his work. He has helped us understand and train our dog thanks to his guidance and personalized attention. We've noticed significant changes in Bruno, and the socialization walks we've been doing are going wonderfully, and we're continuing them.
We are delighted with him. I recommend him 100%.

Excellent treatment and professionalism tailored to your pet's specific needs. My colleague Harsy is treating our pet, and his knowledge and experience are helping us tremendously to address and effectively resolve the problem from the very beginning. If you have a problem, don't hesitate to contact him. Thank you so much, Miguel.

I contacted him about six months ago because my dachshund was very reactive. He'd been attacked by two large dogs before and was traumatized. His reaction to seeing dogs, motorcycles, strollers (anything that moved) was to bark and become very aggressive, to the point of causing me anxiety and preventing me from taking him to many places I used to enjoy. Since we started working with Miguel, Oddi has completely changed. He's a normal dog now 😂. Miguel is a true professional, and I'm eternally grateful. He completely understood Oddi, taught us how to practice with him daily, how to calm his anxiety, what not to do or what we were doing wrong, and explained the reasons behind his behaviors. He loves his job, and it shows. This is Oddi now, interacting with other dogs of different sizes. Before, it was impossible to have a dog in his sight.

Miguel is a true professional. We're working on obedience training with my "little" 45-kilo Cane Corso puppy. Since it's such a strong breed, we're aiming for a high level of socialization and obedience so we can enjoy him. I highly recommend him if you want an obedient and well-behaved dog.

Besides being a wonderful person, Miguel is an excellent professional. We have a Border Collie, Mia, who was 11 months old when I contacted him. Mia was a lost cause, and I had almost given up. Like any good Border Collie, she has the herding instinct running through her veins, and she was constantly putting me in difficult situations, herding any other dog that crossed her path and even people. Sometimes she would bark, bare her teeth, and seem like she was about to attack. This caused me a lot of problems and headaches. That's when I found Miguel through a recommendation after having tried a few other trainers. He was our savior! Three months later, with the sessions spaced out, we were able to get to know each other better, and now Mia comes when I call her and has stopped that behavior that sometimes seemed aggressive. Miguel, I have no words to express my gratitude, especially for the love you show to the animals and for commanding respect, because Mia loved seeing you. It's amazing. Thank you so much!!
